summary: Rage entries from the prepared 1000-title candidate queue, researched for Sami's fidelity-first archive route.

entries.title: Rage
entries.definitive_edition: Current Windows PC release with DLC/edition and config state documented

emulation.fidelity_ceiling: Current PC release with documented settings

primary.version: Current PC release / Anarchy Edition content if owned
primary.why: Rage's PC version has the best capture/settings route for id Tech 5, but texture streaming, config, DLC/Anarchy Edition content, and multiplayer/service state should be documented. Console versions are valid historical routes with lower capture flexibility.
primary.how_to_play: Use the current PC release through Steam/GOG/Bethesda-era ownership. Record storefront/build, DLC/Anarchy Edition state, graphics/config tweaks, texture streaming behavior, controller/mouse input, difficulty, multiplayer/service state, and whether console versions were compared.

secondary.what_to_play: Use if documenting console performance or disc install behavior.
secondary.why: PC is the stronger capture/settings route.

entries.remaster_caveats: Record DLC/Anarchy Edition state, config tweaks, texture streaming behavior, and multiplayer availability.
